Inside · Idea | Who | How
The idea

Your society has more to offer than you think.

Sociva is a GPS-verified community marketplace. It connects residents with home kitchens, tutors, bakers, and local helpers inside the same society.

Made closer to homeFood and goods prepared by people who live where you live.
Skills around the cornerTutors, fitness, pet care, tailoring, and everyday help nearby.
Know who you're buying fromSee the person, chat directly, and read reviews from verified residents.
Not another delivery app. Your neighbourhood, finally visible.
